title: Attack on Riyadh airport killed 12 people and wounded over 300 more, Saudi authorities say
content: Saudi authorities say the latest attack on the international airport in the capital, Riyadh, has killed 12 people and injured over 300. Their statement says the dead on Saturday included four Saudi citizens as well as two Bangladeshi nationals, a Palestinian, a U.S. citizen, an Egyptian, a Jordanian, a Syrian and a Sudanese. It said some of those injured were in critical condition. The attack — the latest of several in the past week on King Khalid International Airport — is expected to increase Saudi pressure on allies including the United States to provide military support for the kingdom.

title: The Kennedy Center names new artistic director, amid concerns

title: At least 2 deaths attributed to Isaias after hurricane bashes Florida and Alabama
content: Hurricane Isaias is blamed for at least two deaths, after the storm made landfall on the Florida coast and ran through Alabama. There are numerous reports of downed trees, with hundreds of thousands of people without power.

title: Opinion: Can I keep the baseball I caught?
content: What would you do if you caught a baseball during the MLB playoffs? Give it to a kid nearby or keep it? This very scenario played out this week, with a fan deciding to keep the ball.

title: Ongoing lawsuits allege GLP-1s can cause serious harm. But we don't know how often

title: After losing ground with Latino voters, Democrats are turning to influencers for help
